exposure: Labor and delivery nurses in the highest quartile of cesarean rates
Labor and delivery nurses in the lowest quartile of cesarean rates
cohort: Nulliparous women who gave birth to term, singleton fetuses in vertex presentation at one high-volume labor and delivery unit at an academic medical center in a major metropolitan area
finding: The adjusted odds of cesarean for births attended by nurses in the highest quartile of cesarean rates was nearly 3 times greater than for births attended by nurses in the lowest quartile.
mod_finding: Nurses in the highest quartile for cesarean birth rates were associated with nearly 3 times the odds of cesarean birth for the women they attended compared to nurses in the lowest quartile.
